principle: Give the actual CorkBot prototype visual priority; explain the current drawing workflow before the future module roadmap.

Responsive QA tool excluded from publication
preserve: Existing signup markup and double-opt-in logic
Canonical URLs, structured data and audience guides
Original product photographs and original concept films

imagery.method: Built-in ImageGen background restyle, not a new photograph. Production provenance is recorded here; public production-note captions removed at operator request on 2026-10-22. Original source remains in the Drawing photo selector.
imagery.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied photograph of the real CorkBot pen drawing robot on its black mat. Asset: cinematic website hero background, landscape 1536x1024. Change ONLY the white studio background to a near-black charcoal studio cyclorama (#101315) with restrained soft studio light. Remove the branding printed in the empty upper left background only. CRITICAL: keep the entire actual robot, all its exact parts, screws, cables, holes, slots, arm, pen, mat, silhouettes, proportions, perspective and pose unchanged. Do not redesign or hallucinate any component, and do not remove or add any hardware. The robot must remain completely visible, with enough neutral rim light to distinguish its black edges against charcoal. Keep full object and mat in frame; preserve composition. Background dark throughout with no bright white areas. No added text, labels, graphics, starfield, smoke, floor patterns, neon or futuristic effects. Photographic understated precision industrial equipment studio image.

implementation_choices: No React or animation runtime added
Taste guidance downloaded locally and adapted to operator direction; not all opinionated prescriptions adopted
Browser QA used the available computer-use browser, not a newly installed Playwright CLI

validation.build: 153 public files; local review tool and docs excluded
validation.responsive: Eight principal pages measured at 390, 768 and 1440 CSS pixels; final no horizontal overflow or broken sourced images
validation.interactions: Mobile menu opens and closes via keyboard; real photo switching; film dialog opens, plays locally and closes
validation.preservation: Launch form markup byte-identical; signup, analytics, routing, headers and release files unchanged
limitations: No hosted deployment or field performance measurement

Full Pages runtime was not started: the separate runtime suite is inappropriate against the simple dev preview (3/5 passed; its cache-header and 404-routing assertions require Pages). Offline suite passes independently.
Browser viewport override had no effect; fixed-width same-origin preview iframe used to verify actual responsive layout instead.

changes: Overlay navigation, full-viewport hero and outlined launch CTA
Dedicated phone and portrait-tablet image framing
Gentle 5.5% zoom and 9% vertical image shift across the first viewport of scrolling
Slower staggered text entrances and restrained image-frame entrances
Native CSS scroll timeline, with static fallback in browsers lacking support; all motion disabled by reduced-motion preference
